pitch:
Mama Fit Core Comeback: an 8-week home program for mums after birth, made by a mum of three and reviewed by a women's health physio.
Nap-sized sessions: 15 to 20 minutes, 4 days a week, for your pelvic floor, tummy gap (diastasis), core, legs and arms. Each exercise shows an easier option, and a guide shows when to stop and see a physio.
Start with a free 1-week quick start (4 sessions). The full 8 weeks is a one-off AUD 19.99, no subscription.
Includes a diastasis self-check video, a small private group of mums starting the same week, and a weekly check-in from the founder. Miss a day and you pick up where you left off.
14-day money-back guarantee. Founding group starts 1 December 2026, limited to 30 mums because the founder does every check-in herself.
Check with your GP or physio before starting.
